title: ROSTrans: Empirically Benchmarking LLMs for ROS1-to-ROS2 Migration
title_zh: ROSTrans：面向ROS1到ROS2迁移的大语言模型实证基准测试

paragraphs.en: ROSTrans基准测试显示前沿LLM在ROS1到ROS2迁移任务上pass@1低于10.9%，多数样本运行时失败。 Although large language models have shown strong capabilities in domain-specific code generation, their performance in robotics software development, especially for the Robot Operating System (ROS), remains largely unexplored. ROS code generation presents distinctive challenges, including complex inter-node coordination, middleware configuration, and lifecycle semantics that go far beyond standard coding benchmarks, and many important correctness properties become observable only once migrated nodes are launched and communicate. We present ROSTrans, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on ROS1-to-ROS2 code migration, a representative and practically important setting for ROS code generation. ROSTrans comprises 108 scaffolded completion tasks drawn from a diverse set of 70+ open-source ROS1 repositories and organized into a hierarchical taxonomy assessing interface-level, behavioral-level and system-level correctness. For every task we establish an executable reference: a verified ROS2 implementation, a runtime test suite that launches the nodes and exercises their topics, services, actions and parameters, and a container ensuring reproducibility. Candidates are scored by injecting only their target files into an otherwise fixed copy of the reference package, so a candidate can neither supply nor weaken the tests it is judged by. Evaluating six frontier LLMs over five stochastic generations per task, we find pass@1 below 10.9%, and that 56.5% of all samples build successfully and then fail at runtime,and 32.0% fail runtime assertions on the migrated interfaces, a class of error no compile-only oracle can detect. Execution-guided repair further improves task success, reaching 49.1% and 47.2% for Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.5 after three rounds, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管大型语言模型在领域特定的代码生成中已展现出强大能力，但其在机器人软件开发中的表现，尤其是在机器人操作系统（ROS）方面，仍然在很大程度上未被探索。ROSTrans 基准测试显示，前沿 LLM 在 ROS1 到 ROS2 迁移任务上的 pass@1 低于 10.9%，多数样本在运行时失败。 ROS 代码生成带来了独特的挑战，包括复杂的节点间协调、中间件配置以及远超标准编码基准的生命周期语义，而且许多重要的正确性属性只有在迁移后的节点被启动并通信时才变得可观测。 我们提出了 ROSTrans，一个用于评估 LLM 在 ROS1 到 ROS2 代码迁移能力的基准，这是 ROS 代码生成中一个具有代表性且在实践中十分重要的场景。 ROSTrans 包含 108 个带有脚手架的补全任务，这些任务来自 70 多个多样化的开源 ROS1 仓库，并被组织成一个分层分类体系，用于评估接口级、行为级和系统级的正确性。 对于每个任务，我们都建立一个可执行的参考：一个经过验证的 ROS2 实现、一个启动节点并测试其话题、服务、动作和参数的运行时测试套件，以及一个确保可复现性的容器。 候选代码的评分方式是仅将其目标文件注入到参考包的一个其余部分保持固定的副本中，因此候选代码既不能提供也无法削弱用于评判它的测试。 通过对六个前沿 LLM 在每个任务上进行五次随机生成来评估，我们发现 pass@1 低于 10.9%，且所有样本中有 56.5% 构建成功后在运行时失败，32.0% 在迁移接口的运行时断言上失败，这是一类任何仅靠编译的判据都无法检测的错误。 基于执行的修复进一步提高了任务成功率，三轮之后 Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.5 分别达到 49.1% 和 47.2%。
